<!-- MIEKE: de titel "Wat mag je ermee?". Gekozen "What you may do with it" (zelfde woorden als
     de voet van elke Engelse bladzij). Alternatieven: "What may you do with it?" (de vraag van
     het Nederlands, stijver in het Engels), "Can I use this?". -->

Everything on this site is free: the book, the exercise books in R, JASP and SPSS, the toys, the archive. Read it, download it, print it, work through it — that is what it is here for.

## For yourself: go ahead

Whether you are a student, a teacher, a researcher, or you simply want to teach yourself statistics — use what you need. You don't have to ask, and you don't have to give anything back.

## Linking is always fine

<!-- MIEKE: "studiehandleiding" — gekozen "course guide"; alternatief "module handbook" (Brits
     universiteitswoord). -->
Want to send someone here — your class, your students, a colleague? Share the link. Put it in your course guide, your syllabus, your email. Pointing people here is never something to ask permission for; it is exactly what I hope you will do.

## Degree programmes: please get in touch first

<!-- MIEKE: "elektronische leeromgeving" — gekozen "virtual learning environment" (het Britse
     woord); alternatief "learning platform". -->
If a programme wants to take the material into its teaching — as required reading, in its virtual learning environment, in a course reader, as course material — I would like to hear about it beforehand. Mail me at [vragen@countcamp.org](mailto:vragen@countcamp.org), and we will agree on something that works for both of us.

<!-- MIEKE: "verwijzen" en "opnemen" — gekozen "pointing to" en "taking in" (Angelsaksisch, en
     het paar blijft een paar). Alternatief: "linking to" en "adopting". -->
The difference lies between *pointing to* and *taking in*: anyone may link to the site, always; making the material itself part of a curriculum starts with a conversation. That goes for the book and for the exercise books alike.

## Support

I make CountCamp in the hours beside my paid work. I would much rather work on it full-time — more room simply means more book: chapters that aren't there yet, exercise books that could be better. If you would like to contribute to that, you can do so here.
